text_block_list.text:
On the day of our return after finishing a 
short-term high-altitude training plan 
with Air Shakur. We were originally 
supposed to take the bus back, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "...Oi. Stop mopin' around already."
choice_data_list: Still, for it to pour that hard...

text_block_list.text:
Due to unexpected heavy rain, the whole 
schedule got pushed back step by step... 
and in the end, we missed the last bus 
too.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to mountain weather, no 
high-tech radar on Earth can predict it 
perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Feelin' responsible for somethin' like 
that is nothin' but arrogance. Focus on a 
realistic way to get back.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
There ain't even cell reception out here. 
Map shows zero houses, zero parking lots, 
nothing.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
We know our location via GPS. All we can 
do is walk down until we hit a spot with 
cell service.

That may be so, but we underwent 
high-intensity training at high altitude. 
Recovery takes time... I don't want to 
overburden you any further.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. Let's go.
choice_data_list: (If I could at least get a signal...)

text_block_list.text:
When I looked around, there was an open 
clearing far off in the distance. That was 
the first thing I had checked when 
entering these mountains—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...Oi, wandering around with a smartphone 
in your hand this whole time... It's an 
eyesore."
choice_data_list: I just wanted to take in the scenery.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
We ain't here for sightseeing, ya know. 
Your body ain't even adjusted to the high 
altitude yet, right?
choice_data_list: Of course I won't push myself too hard.

text_block_list.text:
I didn't tell her, but I checked where 
cell service reached around the training 
grounds. I felt it was necessary just in 
case anything happened.

Back then, I managed to catch a signal a 
few times along the ridge and in open 
areas. The spot I just found is close to 
those locations.

Considering that radio waves radiate 
downward, there might be a slim chance of 
catching a signal! It's dangerous since 
we'll have to go off-trail, but—
choice_data_list: Wait here, okay!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh? Hey...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: I'm so glad we were able to call a car.

text_block_list.text:
After that, we got a signal at the spot I 
noticed. And we safely contacted the 
surface and had them send a car to pick us 
up.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Like hell it's fine. ...You got hurt 
unnecessarily."
choice_data_list: It's just a scratch.
It's just a scratch.

text_block_list.text:
Running frantically through the mountain 
in the dark, she seemed to have caught 
lightly on a tree branch or something.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I mean, seriously. If you were just 
looking for cell service, you should've 
said so back then.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
By analyzing the terrain and distance from 
base stations, we could narrow down where 
signals might reach. It's inefficient, 
time-consuming, and yields few results, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Walking would've definitely been faster. 
That's why... I should've just done 
that...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Don't go wasting your damn breath on 
useless effort.
choice_data_list:
Once in a blue moon, it doesn't go to 
waste. Like today, for instance.

Once in a blue moon, it doesn't go to 
waste. Like today, for instance.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...It's just a coincidence, dammit.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Just like earlier... share the objective 
first. Then I would've gone. That would've 
been faster.
choice_data_list: Maybe that's why they didn't say anything.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Because I wanted to protect you.
Because I wanted to protect you.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ... I told ya I didn't ask for this.
choice_data_list: Get some rest until we arrive
Get some rest until we arrive, okay?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...And after all that, you're the one who 
conked out first?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "Wasted effort"... huh. The nerve of them.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(The stars... They're shining so bright 
it's annoying.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Back when the unscientific claim that the 
sky moved was accepted. Though from their 
perspective back then, claiming the Earth 
moved would've seemed completely insane.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Even so, there were those who piled up 
"wasted effort." Whether it was truly a 
waste or not, everyone already knows by 
now—)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yet "someday" and "coincidence" are too 
far off. That is... what I must prove 
right now.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Barely made it before midnight, huh. 
Tomorrow can go as planned then.
choice_data_list: Make sure you get plenty of rest.
Please make sure to get plenty of rest.
I'll make even more predictions next time.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Barely made it before midnight, huh. 
Tomorrow can go as planned then.
choice_data_list: Make sure you get plenty of rest.
Please make sure to get plenty of rest.
I'll make even more predictions next time.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. Anyone running right now would 
have to be an idiot.
choice_data_list:
Because I want you to give your brain a 
proper rest, too.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Even if you don't worry, I will allocate 
all remaining resources to resting after 
this.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I hear it's because you were desperately 
protecting it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Go ahead and do that.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...I'll do the same.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
However, that ain't something to do today. 
What you need to do is take a quick dip in 
the bath and go right to sleep.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"That's assuming you're really thinking 
about what's next. ...Later."
choice_data_list: Good night.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ... Yeah.
